## Install

1. Download **NotesFloat-*.dmg** below, open it, and drag **Notes Float** to **Applications**.
2. Open it. This build isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks the first launch:
   go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to Notes Float.
   (Or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/NotesFloat.app"` in Terminal.)
3. Allow Notes Float to control **Notes** when asked. Press **⌃⌥N** to show or hide it.

Requires macOS 26 or later (Apple silicon or Intel). Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
